name: returnFromForced
signature: export function returnFromForced(effect: Extract<Effect, { do: 'return-from' }>, ctx: AbilityContext, env: PrimitiveEnv): PrimitiveResult
rules: CR 400.7 a card in a new zone is a new object
CR 608.2 the resolving object does as much as it can
contract: When the eligible pool is at most count, no choice exists: emit one MOVE_ZONE per card and defer nothing. This is the whole point - today the engine defers even when there is nothing to decide.
When the pool is larger than count, emit nothing and defer once, naming the player, the count and the source zone.
An empty pool emits nothing and defers nothing; CR 608.2 says do as much as you can, and nothing is what can be done.
The pool comes from P17 so ordering is deterministic across clients.
count of zero or less emits nothing.

evidence.claim: cards move as a set and an empty set is a no-op

why.textMustContain: from your graveyard to your hand
from your graveyard to your hand

assertions.given: Raise Dead with exactly one creature in the graveyard
assertions.expect: one MOVE_ZONE to hand, zero deferred

assertions.given: Raise Dead with three creatures in the graveyard
assertions.expect: zero actions, one deferred naming the choice

assertions.given: a graveyard holding a land when the filter says creature
assertions.expect: the land is not eligible and is not moved
